comment: Ordered rules, first match wins (case-insensitive, anywhere in the text). GPU = the system Vulkan device name ("Adreno (TM) 642L", "Mali-G610 MC6"); then SoC model (Build.SOC_MODEL / ro.soc.model) when the GPU matches nothing; then RAM caps the result. RAM thresholds use the kernel-reported total (an advertised 8 GB phone reports about 7.3 GB). Adreno numbers are not generations: 725-750 are the 8 Gen 1-3 (and 7+ Gen 2-3) flagships, 810 is a 7s Gen 3 / 6 Gen 4 mid-range GPU, 70x are entry level. Mali G610/G615 count as Trung binh only with 6 or more cores (Dimensity 8100-8300). See docs/agvn/hieu-nang-moi-may.md.
